messages.author: b78114f8e8a68ea3
messages.subject: PLS.Observations in the same order
parts:
Dear community,

I’m trying to perform two.b.pls() analysis from coordinates from two different bones. My problem is that the function assumes that “the separate inputs have specimens (observations) in the same order” and mines are not. I’m aware that this is a very simple question, but I cannot find how to put the specimens (and their coordinates) in the same order on the internet. I’ve tried with “order” function, but nothing works.

Thanks in advance,

E.G.

messages.author: c0e9ac0f353e108b
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] PLS.Observations in the same order
parts:
Hi Eric,

Reordering coordinates can be accomplished using the match function. If you have two datasets of landmarks, lms_1 and lms_2, it could look like this:
lms_2_reordered <- lms_2[,,match(dimnames(lms_1)[[3]], dimnames(lms_2)[[3]])]

Your inputs would then be lms_1 and lms_2_reordered.

Best,
Erica Baken
